name: TensorPM v1.40.0
body:
# Changelog - v1.40.0

This update explains your schedule in the Gantt, lets you choose how deeply each AI model thinks,
and reworks how the Distiller presents and applies its proposals.

## 📅 Timeline and Gantt

- The Gantt shows the critical path: which tasks drive the project end, how much float the others
  have, and where dependencies conflict with the planned dates. All figures are in working days.
- Conflicts can be resolved in place, with a preview of the moves and of the shift of the project
  end. A block reason can be edited right in the chart.
- Snapshots ("Stände") record the plan: manually, once a week automatically, and one baseline per
  project. Comparing a snapshot with today shows what moved, by how many working days, and what was
  pushed along by dependencies.
- Moves are explained by their causes: changes from the chat or the Distiller and linked decisions.
  You can document a reason as a decision or ask the agent about the differences.
- Canvas labels (months, weekdays, calendar weeks) follow the app language. Keyboard shortcut hints
  on the chart are now hidden by default and can be turned on in the view settings.

## 🧠 AI

- Settings › AI has a reasoning level ("Denktiefe") per model, with exactly the levels that model
  supports. Existing installs keep their previous behaviour; the former Anthropic thinking switch
  is carried over.
- Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5 replace Fable 5 and Opus 5. Saved model choices move to the
  successor.

## 🔍 Distiller

- Proposal cards show the change on the object it affects: old and new values side by side, dates
  and amounts with their difference, table rows as records.
- With two or more proposals, nothing is written on the last click: a commit step lists exactly
  what will be written before you apply it. A short input lock after every card switch prevents a
  double click from deciding a card you have not seen.
- After sending, the signal shows what actually happened: applying, applied, partially confirmed or
  not finished, read from the trail. "View in trail" opens the trail filtered to that signal.
- No more layout jumps while reviewing.

## 🌐 Language

- People, trail, budget, intake and connector texts appear in the app language; amounts use the
  separators of the app language, and message times read "Today at 3:45 PM" / "Heute um 15:45".

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.40.0
- **Release Date**: 2026-09-27
- **Previous Version**: 1.39.4
- **Type**: Minor Release
